svg.text: The one idea to keep

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Genie's answer quality = the quality of the knowledge layer beneath it. Raw tables make it guess; the metric view makes it inherit.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The modelling work you did in sections 7–9 is exactly what makes natural-language querying trustworthy. Genie is good for free, IF the model is good.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ask questions your data can answer

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Good: top categories by revenue · revenue trend by month · best-selling brand · revenue by payment mode or channel.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Avoid (null): which customer buys most · revenue by country · deal stage breakdown — all read the empty opportunity columns.
